caption: The video captures a large conical pile of cut branches, twigs, and leafy brushwood burning in a clearing ringed by tall slender trees. An orange fire is already established inside the hollow center, its glow visible through gaps in the sticks while small flames flicker along the right-hand edge. A steady column of pale grey-white smoke rises from the upper-left part of the pile and drifts upward with changing density. The outer brushwood keeps a broadly stable shape across the excerpt while the interior fire continues to burn, with no new branch added to the pile. The foreground is bare reddish-brown soil, and a small dirt mound sits at the left edge of the frame. The camera framing widens slightly over time, revealing more of the ground, mound, and tree line while keeping the pile roughly centered. No people, tools, or animals appear, and the visible motion consists of the fire's flicker, the rising smoke, and the gradual camera adjustment.
relations: Interior fire burning -> orange glow visible through gaps and small flames flicker along the right edge.
Combustion of brushwood -> steady column of pale grey-white smoke rises from upper-left and drifts upward.
Stable outer brushwood -> pile shape remains broadly constant while interior fire continues without new branches added.
Gradual camera adjustment -> framing widens slightly, revealing more of the ground, mound, and surrounding tree line.
